guard_rules: activity, stock, deployment and infrastructure != direct GHG measurement
conversion factors, ETS factors and reporting tools != observed emissions
scheme applications, vouchers, grants and product eligibility != measured emissions reductions
local-authority, national and industry aggregates != individual parcel values
provisional != final; correction/revision history must be retained
publication date != reference period; future announcements are not observed data
certificates, allowances and market/compliance records != physical parcel emissions
no unsupported conversion from vehicle counts or fuel-policy metrics to parcel emissions
no parcel emissions value may be inferred without the separate parcel-binding measurement gate
